_readme: S741, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-27), second read. Three Orange Coast records hold on what their own pages print, each read here as the capture reads it. 08628 (Construction Technology: Residential Construction Dev A.S.): its page's heading reads 'Building Construction, Associate in Science Degree'; the page's printed Control Number says whether it is 08628's own. 43100 (Athletic Training Level 2 certificate): the state's list names PSYC A160, which the record does not place or explain. 03993 (Dance A.A.): 18-21 against the printed 20. Three loads. No model call, nothing written.

questions.control_number: The Control Number the page prints, with its heading.
questions.psyc_a160: Whether the Athletic Training Level 2 page prints PSYC A160 anywhere, and under which list.
questions.dance_figures: Each Dance list's courses with units, each list's printed figure and the total line, word for word.
